[/size][/b][b][size=4]How to use[/size][/b]
config.json will appear once you've loaded the mod at least once OR [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]

[spoiler]This mod only changes the upper room via the vanilla farmhouse2 / farmhouse2_marriage, and reapplies cellar stairs (so reloading from title wouldn't be necessary whenever [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is used to enable/disable, [i][u]if you don't use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] and reload game for configuration updates, ignore this.[/u][/i])

[color=#f6b26b][b]Extra information:[/b] [/color][color=#9fc5e8]when [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is used to enable/disable mod, it loads farmhouse2 / farmhouse2_marriage without applying the cellar stairs (the [b]cellar[/b] itself remains [b]unaffected[/b]/[b]unchanged[/b] as you left it - this has been [b]confirmed via wren greenhouse's warp hatch to cellar ladder[/b]), reloading from title sets your farmhouse back as it was - but with the updated configuration choices. Added renovations/modular rooms = [b]south room[/b]/[b]north east corner room[/b] were [b]unaffected[/b] by this.

In order to [b]negate[/b] the [b]extra step of reloading from title[/b] [u]per saved configuration modification via [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url][/u], this mod [b]includes reapplication of cellar stairs[/b] if there's a cellar present.[/color] [b]Re-entering the house should apply the changes as well[/b][/spoiler]
